_README: FROZEN acceptance-coverage debt ceiling — enforced by
Semantics: ceilings.status.<status> and ceilings.debt_class.<A|B|C|D> are the
MAXIMUM number of criteria that may carry that status / class. Measured >
ceiling => CI FAILS. ceilings.total_criteria is a FLOOR, not a ceiling: the
corpus may grow, never shrink, so deleting an inconvenient `partial` row
cannot read as progress. Measured < ceiling => CI prints the tightened block
for you to paste back here; lowering a ceiling after real work is expected.
Every number here is MEASURED DEBT, not an allowance. There is no headroom by
design: a ceiling set above the measured figure would silently license the
next unproven criterion. Raising one is an adjudication recorded in
This ratchet bounds how much of the acceptance contract is UNPROVEN. It is not
a project-completion figure: a criterion counted here may well be implemented
correctly — the claim is only that nothing in the suite asserts it.

provenance.slice: acceptance batch 09 — doc 03 (Add Outsource Signal), BACKEND surface: AOS-05 and AOS-13 closed; AOS-04.c2 and AOS-06.c2 measured as unfalsifiable
provenance.base_commit: ff4ed01 (stacked on batch 08 / ADIM 76, itself on batch 07 / ADIM 75; main at 8151cdc)
provenance.conditions: static scan; ast + title extraction against the live test tree; no database, no network, no test run
provenance.supersedes: the batch-08 freeze (93 partial / 8 uncovered; A1 B62 C6 D32, base 79c1011). Batch 09 took doc 03 (Add Outsource Signal) and ONE surface (backend), and closed TWO criteria, so partial 93 -> 91 and class B 62 -> 60; both ceilings are lowered, never raised. AOS-13.c3 drove the one role doc 03 §13 names and the suite never exercised - a SUPERVISOR - against BOTH verbs (create_work_object_revision and soft_delete_work_object) over BOTH external kinds, with a valid anti-lookahead available_time so the denial is attributable to authorization rather than validation. AOS-05.c1 pinned the trade_log branch of the transient-draft contract in its own right instead of borrowing its trading_signal sibling. Both were negative-controlled: a Role.SUPERVISOR short-circuit in can_edit gives DID NOT RAISE AccessDeniedError on both parametrisations, and returning a root_id for the TRADE_LOG branch only fails the new test while leaving the sibling green. THREE rows were MEASURED AND RECORDED RATHER THAN ACTED ON. AOS-04.c2 is the verbatim twin of TS-02.c2 and unfalsifiable for the same reason (the draft opener is a pure session-less function, so a transient draft has no representation the Ready Check composition could omit). AOS-06.c2 is worse: grepping discard across the mainboard command and route modules returns NOTHING - there is no discard surface at all, only a frontend comment saying leaving the page discards nothing durable - so the clause asserts that a non-action has no effect. AOS-01.c2 (keyboard parity of the chooser) IS genuinely closable but is FRONTEND, so it was left to a doc-03 frontend batch, exactly as doc 07 split across batches 06 and 07. NEITHER FINDING WAS RECLASSIFIED - B -> C raises the C ceiling and that is an adjudication, not a test slice's call. That makes THIRTEEN such open findings across the ledger.

adjudication.why_a_ceiling_and_not_a_failure: Turning 139 open criteria into a hard CI failure blocks every unrelated PR behind work no single slice can do. Leaving them unbounded is how the number grew unnoticed. The ceiling is the same trade frontend/e2e/a11y-baseline.json already makes: today's debt is frozen, and only GROWTH is red.
adjudication.class_D_is_not_test_debt: 32 of the open criteria name an error code, model field, validator or Agent Tool Gateway member that does not exist in backend/src. No test can close them; counting them as coverage debt budgets product work to a test slice. They are ratcheted separately so that closing class B cannot mask class D growing.
adjudication.class_C_is_never_closable: 6 criteria rest on a clause that is not assertable by nature — a statement about the V18 mockup document, another page's document scope, a V1 feature deliberately left closed (retention auto-purge, doc 20 §16), or a scenario Production cannot construct (CP-06, SUPPORTED_TARGET_RUNTIMES == {python}). Their ceiling must never be driven to zero; driving it down would mean someone invented a product to satisfy a document sentence.
adjudication.O-31_active_run_refusal_name: Three page documents named ONE refusal three ways: ACTIVE_RUN_DEPENDENCY (doc 03 §14, doc 04 §15), DELETE_BLOCKED_BY_RUNNING_JOB (doc 20 §15) and OBJECT_IN_ACTIVE_RUN (doc 01/15). Only the last ships. Settled the O-02 way — the SHIPPED name is canonical, the other two are historical — and pinned by backend/tests/integration/test_backtest_persistence.py::test_active_run_blocks_work_object_delete, which now asserts the wire code and http_status 409 instead of the exception class alone.
adjudication.class_B_batches_are_deliberately_small: 101 open class-B criteria cannot be closed in one pass without the review degenerating into a rubber stamp — and a criterion marked covered by a test that does not actually prove it is worse than one honestly left partial. Batches are therefore scoped to one page document and one surface (batch 01 = doc 05, backend). Each closed clause cites a node that fails when the behaviour is removed; where the assertion could plausibly pass vacuously it was negative-controlled by hand (see the notes on TL-03, TL-15 and TL-17 in acceptance_semantic_map.yaml).
adjudication.TL_11_c3_is_very_likely_class_C_not_B: ADIM 49 finding, recorded rather than acted on. TL-11.c3 names a run over an ALLOCATION-ENABLED composition. Shared capital allocation is fail-closed at ADMISSION in this build (domain/allocation/capability.py SHARED_ALLOCATION_STATUS = 'future_dev'; commands/backtest_run.py raises ALLOCATION_SHARED_MODE_NOT_IN_BUILD before any run, manifest or job exists), so the run the clause describes cannot be constructed and NO test can close it. That is the class C definition, not class B. It was NOT moved: B -> C would RAISE the C ceiling, and ceilings only fall except by adjudication. ADIM 48's kickoff recommended this row as closable; that was wrong. Two such findings are now open — this and TL-16 (c4 wants a 409 field that does not exist, so class D).
adjudication.three_more_doc12_clauses_look_misclassif: ADIM 54 findings, recorded rather than acted on — the same shape as the TL-11.c3 finding of ADIM 52. RD-01.c4 wants an ANALYSIS-time DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED gate that does not exist and is not needed (market_entity_id is required at create). RD-05.c5 wants an Agent research draft/analysis tool; ToolName exposes none. RD-11.c2 wants the evidence bundle to pin feature definitions, time policies and mapping ids; _seal_bundle members carry five fields and none of those three. None was moved: B -> C/D RAISES a ceiling, and ceilings only fall except by adjudication. FIVE such findings are now open across the ledger (TL-11.c3, TL-16, TL-01.c4 and these three clauses), which is itself the signal: ADIM 42 classified from each record's own notes without re-reading product code, and said so.
adjudication.PC_02_c2_empty_input_text_is_unconstruct: ADIM 76 finding, recorded rather than acted on — the ninth of this shape, and the second on doc 07. PC-02.c2 wants the Pre-Check surface to show a 'final empty-input text' for an EMPTY SOURCE (doc 07 §16: 'UI shows TA PRE-CHECK RESULT with final empty-input text'). Measured on base 0f0651d, two independent reasons it is not class B. (1) The copy does not exist: EMPTY_SOURCE appears NOWHERE in frontend/src, and the only EmptyState on the Pre-Check page (pages/PreCheck.tsx:123) reads 'No requests yet' — an empty request LIST, not an empty source. (2) Decisively, the state is UNCONSTRUCTIBLE on the shipped surface: the overlay renders as `{precheckOpen && detail !== null ? <PreCheckModal … />}` (pages/CreatePackage.tsx:765), so Pre-Check cannot be opened without a persisted request, while a request with an empty source can never be persisted because normalize_request raises EMPTY_SOURCE at the route before the DB. There is no reachable screen on which an empty-input Pre-Check result could render, which is the class C definition ('a scenario Production cannot construct'), not test debt. It was NOT moved: B -> C would RAISE the C ceiling, and ceilings only fall except by adjudication. Note this differs from PC-20.c3 on the same document: that one IS constructible and simply unimplemented (class D), whereas this one cannot be reached at all.
adjudication.PC_20_c3_restored_request_staleness_is_c: ADIM 72 finding, recorded rather than acted on — the eighth of this shape. PC-20.c3 says 'a restored package REQUEST comes back stale'. Doc 07 §5's 'deleted / restored request' lifecycle row does demand it ('restored request current dependencies için stale kabul edilir'), but NOTHING IMPLEMENTS IT. Measured on base df7df92: a package request IS a trashable registry root (entity_type='package_request'), so the scenario is constructible and this is not class C. Restore, however, goes through commands/deletion.py::_restore_registry_target — the generic branch — which only returns deletion_state to ACTIVE and clears deleted_at/deleted_by/delete_reason. There is no package-request branch (the typed ones are backtest_result, manual_document, hypothesis_artifact). cp_repo.get_current_scan then reads detail.current_scan_id through a plain session.get with NO deletion filter, so the pre-delete PASSED scan survives intact, and _enforce_precheck_gate compares only context_hash and registry_fingerprint — neither of which a delete/restore cycle moves. A restored request therefore passes the Send gate instead of coming back stale. Closing this needs a restore-time staleness marker (product work), so the row is class D, not test debt. It was NOT moved: B -> D would RAISE the D ceiling, and ceilings only fall except by adjudication.
adjudication.doc16_event_names_are_shipped_names: ADIM 55. Doc 16 names two audit events RESULT_SOFT_DELETED and RESULT_RESTORED. Neither string exists: the shipped kinds are `backtest.result_soft_deleted` (written by the command) and `trash.restored` (written by the generic trash restore path). Settled the O-02 / O-31 way — the SHIPPED name is canonical and the document's is historical — and the restore assertion additionally pins target_entity_id to the result id, so it proves THIS result's restore was audited rather than that some trash activity occurred. Renaming shipped event kinds to match a document sentence would break every consumer for a spelling.
adjudication.TS_07_c2_engine_signal_gate_pathway_does: ADIM 76 finding, recorded rather than acted on — the tenth of this shape. TS-07.c2 says the engine decision gate withholds a signal event from a bar starting before its available_time. Measured on base 0f0651d: run_engine's parameters are strategy_config, bar_batches, execution_key, item_count, indicator_plan, timeframe, allocation, funding, tick_batches, portfolio_rules and builtin_breakout_fixture — there is NO signal-event input. jobs/backtest_engine.py contains zero references to trading_signal; nothing under domain/backtest/ imports domain/trading_signal/events.py (its only consumers are the import/normalize plane); and engine.py's SignalEventRow is the engine's own OUTPUT journal of stop_resolution decisions, not an ingested feed. The single available_at gate in the engine belongs to the funding/research axis via is_eligible_for_decision, which this row was already told not to borrow. The schema-level refusal is real and proven; the engine-side half cannot be asserted until a signal-event feed reaches the engine at all. That is product work, i.e. class D. It was NOT moved: B -> D raises the D ceiling.
adjudication.TS_02_c2_transient_draft_exclusion_is_tr: ADIM 76 finding, recorded rather than acted on — the eleventh, and a different shape from the others: not unshipped and not unconstructible, but UNFALSIFIABLE as written. TS-02.c2 wants the Ready Check snapshot and the Run to exclude a transient draft. Measured on base 0f0651d: commands/mainboard.py::start_external_work_object_draft (104-117) is a PURE function taking only (actor, kind); it opens no session and returns {draft_id, kind, unsaved: True}, and its single caller routes/mainboard.py:91-95 passes ctx.actor and kind and nothing else. There is no database handle in scope anywhere on that path, so a transient draft cannot reach MainboardCompositionSnapshot.item_manifest (built from mb_repo.list_active_items) by any route. A test asserting the draft id is absent from the manifest would pass today and could only fail after a three-point change (give the opener a session, add a write, wire the id into the snapshot) — that is not a regression a guard catches. Writing it would satisfy the scanner while proving nothing, which this ledger explicitly refuses, so the clause was left uncovered with the measurement recorded. Closing it honestly needs a persisted-draft design (as I-12 already did for Strategy, replacing the transient opener with a real root) or an adjudication that the row is class C.
adjudication.AOS_06_c2_discard_has_no_surface: ADIM 77 finding, recorded rather than acted on - the thirteenth, and the starkest instance of the unfalsifiable shape. AOS-06.c2 says discarding an unsaved draft changes no composition hash and emits no Ready Report stale event. Measured on this base: grepping discard across application/commands/mainboard.py and apps/api/routes/mainboard.py returns NOTHING. There is no discard command, no discard endpoint, no discard handler. The single mention anywhere in the tree is a comment at frontend/src/pages/OutsourceSignal.tsx:97 - 'leaving this page discards nothing durable' - which describes the absence rather than implementing it. Discarding is navigating away from a client-side view whose opener never touched the server. A test would therefore assert that nothing does nothing: green today and unable to go red through any single realistic change. The load-bearing half of the row (no Trash Entry, no audit event) is already asserted via the draft's lack of identity. Not moved: B -> C raises the C ceiling.
adjudication.AOS_04_c2_is_the_TS_02_c2_twin: ADIM 77 finding, the twelfth, and a verbatim repeat of the TS-02.c2 adjudication one slice earlier - recorded again here because the row lives on a different page document and a future slice reading only doc 03 would otherwise re-plan it. AOS-04.c2 wants the server Ready Check composition to omit a transient draft. The row's own pre-existing note already conceded the shape ('Structurally the draft has no composition row to omit, but that is an argument, not an assertion'). The measurement is identical to TS-02.c2: start_external_work_object_draft is a pure function over (actor, kind) with no session, its only caller passes nothing else, and the composition snapshot is built from mb_repo.list_active_items - so the draft cannot appear there by any route, and an absence assertion could only fail after a three-point change. Not moved: B -> C raises the C ceiling.
